summary: 2 errors, 19 minor issues. Errors: u118 English drops netra (eyes); u122 stanaubhruvau printed spacing error unflagged and hyphenated as a compound. Main minors: Hindi pārśva/jatru/tāraka/citta hedges and glossary compliance (u118), '(the following)' filler in u137, English/Hindi mismatch for uttarottarasukṣetram (u138), 'very' dropped from kṛśa (u127), ambiguous 'interval' (u122), Hindi supplied unit (u112), vṛttau gender (u120). Damaged units (u118, u119, u132, u135) are handled as the glossary says (unsplit, unclear, low confidence). No plant/drug identifications; body-part identifications (hanu, tālu, meḍhra, nābhi, hṛdaya, śaṅkha, śirā standard; jatru, stanāgra, manyā, guhya probable) are acceptable, jatru now hedged in the translation. Human decisions: u118 sakthi vs ūru and tvakacakarajana candidate; u123 reading; u143 (sattvān vs sattvavān); u144 satya/asteya; u145 guṇaḥ/guṇāḥ; u131 split across tokens. No regrouping needed; u117 may list undesirable extremes (it follows aniṣṭa in u115) but the draft's hedged note is adequate.
